![](images/pint_science_cropped.jpg){.hero-float-img}

Hi, I'm Bea. I'm a postdoc in the [Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/casa) (CASA) at UCL, where I work on the AI for Collective Intelligence (AI4CI) project. I use machine learning methods to understand what is being constructed in London and its implications for the housing crisis.

My research interests include applied machine learning, mathematical modelling, data analysis, public policy, science communication and (unrelatedly) knitting.

### Current stuff

- <span class="year-pill">2025-26</span> I lecture Quantitative Methods - a course on CASA's Urban Spatial Science MSc
- <span class="year-pill">2026</span> UCL Public Policy Knowledge Broker Fellow

### Past stuff

- <span class="year-pill">2021-24</span> I completed my PhD in the Computer Science department at UCL, within the Centre for Medical Image Computing. My PhD work focussed on the development and application of ML & disease progression models to improve understanding of the rarer dementias
- <span class="year-pill">2023</span> PhD placement: project assistant on the Royal Institution's Christmas Lectures, *The Truth about AI*, presented by Mike Wooldridge
- <span class="year-pill">2024</span> PhD placement: research assistant at the policy think tank The Autonomy Institute, researching regional patterns of underdiagnosis
- <span class="year-pill">2021-23</span> Edited and illustrated [Chalkdust](https://chalkdustmagazine.com/) magazine
